FileMaker ADT plugin

fm-adt-helper

Uses Claris ADT as the native agentic lane on equipped machines.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The ADT-equipped alternative

This plugin is installed in place of fm-dc where the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit is available, carrying its connection lifecycle and authoring discipline.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Two-lane architecture for fm CLI schema work and MCP/script work
  • NDJSON operation discipline and connection recovery playbooks
  • Native layout authoring with known rendering traps documented
  • Web viewer application pipeline
  • ADT Helper window snapshots for visual verification

The handoff

01IntentFileMaker change
02ADToperates
03Snapshotcaptures
04Checksverify
05Recordships

Why it matters

Use the native lane when it exists

The alternative package keeps PM and Ringer unchanged while swapping in the richer ADT execution surface. The project still produces the same kind of bounded work and evidence; only the FileMaker mechanism changes.
